titulo: Live: A demonstrator died from 'cardiorespiratory arrest' during Paris protests, police say
cuerpo: A demonstrator died from cardiorespiratory arrest during Saturday's protests in Paris, police said Sunday, stressing that the death was not connected to police action or to the clashes that broke out on the margins of the mass demonstrations across the capital. The city's police prefecture said they had detained a "record figure" of 855 people in the capital during the demonstrations. Follow our liveblog for all the latest developments.
